html:
Effect

Loyal can only be assigned to Crewmates or Impostors, not Neutrals. It prevents conversion by recruiting roles. Separate settings control whether Impostors and Crewmates can receive it.

Settings

  • Max: Maximum number that can appear in one match.
  • Spawn Chance: Chance for a player to receive this add-on.
  • Eligibility: Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates can receive this add-on.
